description: Build nextjs-b2b-saas starter - Organizations, teams, and RBAC with Next.js, Auth0, PostgreSQL/Drizzle, Paddle, and Postmark. Must follow Web SaaS blueprint. Create on branch feat/nextjs-b2b-saas from current HEAD.
steps: Create and checkout branch feat/nextjs-b2b-saas from current HEAD (feat/astro-beginner-static-site)

Create nextjs-b2b-saas/ directory with exact-pinned Next.js 15 App Router scaffold (package.json with pnpm 10.x packageManager field, exact versions for next, react, react-dom, typescript, @auth0/nextjs-auth0, drizzle-orm, drizzle-kit, @paddle/paddle-node-sdk, postmark (or nodemailer + postmark transport), tailwindcss, vitest, fast-check, eslint, eslint-config-next, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom, postgres driver like pg or @neondatabase/serverless)
Add starter.json matching catalog entry (id:3, folder:nextjs-b2b-saas, family:Web SaaS, etc.)
Create domain/entities.ts with Organization, Membership, Role, Customer, Subscription, ProcessedEvent interfaces
Create domain/policies.ts with deny-by-default RBAC: role hierarchy (owner > admin > member), action permissions matrix, organization-scoped access

Create lib/server/config.ts with typed ConfigSpec for AUTH0_SECRET, AUTH0_BASE_URL, AUTH0_ISSUER_BASE_URL, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, PADDLE_API_KEY, PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, POSTMARK_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts (same sanitized error pattern)
Create drizzle/ directory with schema.ts (Drizzle ORM schema for all entities) and migrations/
Create drizzle.config.ts for migration tooling
Create lib/server/auth.ts - Auth0 adapter for identity and org context extraction

Create lib/server/billing.ts - Paddle BillingPort interface (createCheckout, verifyWebhook, handleWebhookEvent) and lib/server/billing-fake.ts with in-memory fake supporting subscription state machine (active, past_due, cancelled, trialing)
Create lib/server/mail.ts - Postmark MailPort interface (sendInvite) and lib/server/mail-fake.ts with in-memory fake
Create lib/server/database.ts - Drizzle-based repositories for Organization, Membership, Customer, Subscription
Create lib/server/providers.ts - provider selection based on placeholder detection
Create middleware.ts using @auth0/nextjs-auth0 for route protection
Create app/page.tsx - public product entry page
Create app/auth/ routes - Auth0 login/callback/logout
Create app/dashboard/ - protected admin dashboard with org management, role assignment, customer creation, subscription status
Create app/api/webhooks/paddle/route.ts - Paddle webhook with raw body verification and idempotent event processing
Create app/api/invite/route.ts - invite endpoint sending Postmark email
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts - RBAC matrix tests (all role/action combinations)
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts - Paddle fake adapter tests
Create tests/unit/server/mail.test.ts - Postmark fake adapter tests
Create tests/unit/server/config.test.ts - config validation tests
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts - unauthenticated denial, unauthorized denial, role-based access
Create tests/integration/actions.test.ts - core use-case actions (create org, assign role, create customer)
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts - Property 4: Authentication and access consistency with RBAC
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts - Property 5: Webhook authenticity gates one state transition (Paddle)
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts - build verification
Create .env.example with classified sections
Create README.md documenting setup, RBAC model, schema, Auth0 config, Paddle, Postmark, tests, deployment
Add vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, next.config.ts, tailwind config
Run pnpm install to generate pnpm-lock.yaml
Verify: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build all pass
Git commit all files on feat/nextjs-b2b-saas branch
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-b2b-saas/ directory exists at repo root with all Web SaaS blueprint files
starter.json matches catalog entry id:3 exactly
pnpm run test passes (all tests including RBAC matrix)
Fake adapters activate with placeholder env values
Property tests use fast-check with at least 100 runs
RBAC policies enforce deny-by-default for all role/action combinations
Paddle webhook verification covers valid/invalid signatures
verification: cd nextjs-b2b-saas && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
